description: Update Support Agent settings (partial patch — only send fields to change).

allow_list.description: Visitor allow list (emails, @handles, Jiji seller ids, X ids). Empty list = allow all visitors.

auto_reply_allowed_channels.description: Channels where the agent may send AI auto-replies. Empty = all channels (still filtered by allow_list).

followup_email_message.description: Email opening template (UI: Outreach opening messages → Email). Used for Leads Discovery Message now, bulk follow-up, and first inbound CRM email auto-reply.

followup_instagram_message.description: Instagram DM opening template for outreach compose.

followup_telegram_message.description: Telegram opening template for outreach compose.

followup_whatsapp_message.description: WhatsApp opening template for outreach compose.

followup_x_message.description: X DM opening template for outreach compose.

x_ld_attention_use_custom.description: When true, use agent-specific X Leads Discovery public attention (Lane A/B).

x_ld_public_only.description: Cold LD import: public quote/reply only, no DMs.

name: admin__update_agent
